subject: planner: fix incorrect `TblColPosInfo` calculation in `buildDelete` after column pruning (#64698)
summary: Reviewed this commit (vs first parent) focused on planner DELETE column-position mapping. The change correctly shifts `TblColPosInfo.Start/End` and `HandleCols` indices by the number of previously pruned columns in the skip-pruning path (e.g., partitioned tables), aligning with executor usage of `[Start,End)` slicing and handle building. No Blocker/High issues found; no later upstream/master follow-up changes in this area observed.
